text: いちど　たたかった　トレーナーと　また　しょうぶ　してみたい！

structure.jp: いちど　たたかった　トレーナーと
structure.en: with a Trainer I fought once

structure.jp: また　しょうぶ　してみたい！
structure.en: I want to try battling again!

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: しょうぶ　してみたい
patterns.explanation: The て-form followed by みる means to try doing something and see how it goes. しょうぶ　してみたい = 'I want to try having a battle'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on the end of a verb means the speaker wants to do it. してみたい = 'I want to try doing it'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: いちど　たたかった　トレーナー
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a noun describes that noun, like 'that' in English. いちど　たたかった　トレーナー = 'a Trainer that I fought once'.
